Outsider (Chaotic, Evil) · 2 hexes · SM +1 Howler [Monster Manual, page 154]

A long ash-grey quadruped with a huge toothed mouth and a mane of black-and-ivory quills over neck and shoulders. It sheds those quills into whatever it claws. Its howl carries for miles and wears down the nerve of anyone who has to keep listening to it.
